verses.text: “Even today my complaint is defiant. His hand still weighs heavy on me, even though I’m groaning.
If only I knew where to find him! If only I could get all the way to his seat!
I’d lay out my case before him and have every argument ready to say.
I’d hear how he’d answer me and understand what he had to tell me.
Would he use all his power to argue against me? No, he’d listen to me.
There an upright person could reason with him, and I’d be free from my judge for good.
“If I go east, he isn’t there. If I go west, I can’t find him.
He’s at work in the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch even a glimpse of him.
But he knows the road I’m on. When he’s tested me, I’ll come out like gold.
My feet have stayed in his steps. I’ve kept to his road and haven’t turned away.
I haven’t backed away from what he commanded. I’ve treasured the words he spoke more than the food I need.
But he stands alone. Who can stand against him? Whatever he wants to do, he does.
He carries out what he’s appointed for me, and he has many things like that in store.
That’s why I’m terrified in his presence. When I think it through, I’m afraid of him.
God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.
I wasn’t cut off before the darkness came, and he didn’t hide the thick darkness from my face.
